name: XLJ001
summary: XLJ001 is the published patrol-robot controller PCBA configuration from Live Electronics. The manufacturer lists Wi-Fi/Bluetooth communication, automatic route planning and automatic charging. It is supplied within a custom board-development and integration offering; broad optional feature lists are not assumed to be the delivered configuration.
